newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Ceval nine-month net $22.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Ceval nine-month net $22.8 mln.

text.p: Brazilian food company Ceval Alimentos said it had a $22.824 million net profit in the first nine months of the year.
The company said its net profit in the third quarter amounted to $35.121 million, which contributed to offset the firm's losses of $12.3 million in the first half.
Ceval said in a statement $12.269 million of the company's net profit in the third quarter was related to its pre-tax operating profit.
The company also said its revenues rose 8.45 percent to $2.061 billion between January and September when compared with the same period last year.
Ceval's investment plan for 1996 totals $62 million, of which $51.8 million were invested in the first nine months, it added.
Ceval preferred stock closed at 9.65 reais, down 1.53 percent, on Tuesday on the Sao Paulo bourse.
